description: Get a one-hour signed upload URL for an image or a zip that is too large to send inline (over 3 MB; up to 100 MB here) or that already sits on disk. PUT the raw bytes to upload_url with a Content-Length header, then pass file_id to process_images. Free.

bytes.description: Exact size of the file you will upload, in bytes (at most 100 MB)

filename.description: Original file name, used to name the output

name: create_upload
